failures.mode_definition: pi0 approaches, grasps and manipulates a non-instructed object in the scene instead of the instructed target object.
hl_remedy: RETREAT(dz=+0.05) then lower and open gripper to set the wrong object back down near its start
REPROMPT('pick up the orange juice and put it in the basket')
WATCH(EE approaches the orange juice, 5 s)
on no approach: retry once with VERIFY of the target at pre-grasp, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Before allowing gripper closure, VERIFY the object under the gripper is the instructed target (pre-grasp identity check); HALT as soon as the EE descends over a non-target object for 2 frames. Advance to a second object only when the coordinator's plan asks for it (single-object instruction here).
failures.observation: 53-107 gripper low between milk and juice, fingers to the left of the juice, no closure seen; 113 rises; 120-127 directly above the milk; 140-147 milk lifted; 187-213 milk lowered into the basket; 280-353 small orange box grasped; 380-393 box lowered into the basket.

notes: Whether the 53-107 hover was an aborted grasp of the juice (LL) or a hesitation between candidates (HL) cannot be decided from video; no finger contact with the juice is visible, so it is folded into the HL call. The second wrong object (orange box) is a continuation of the same behaviour, recorded in subtasks/observation rather than as a separate failure. Identity of the small orange box as 'butter' is a guess from appearance.
